experiment.topic: BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion under liquidity friction and order flow imbalance
experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD hourly VWAP deviations exceeding a 4% threshold over a 20-hour lookback are statistically likely to revert to mean within the next 30 minutes due to micro-liquidity frictions and asymmetric order flow imbalances.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion with 4% threshold and 20-hour lookback fails to show statistically significant mean reversion in at least 30% of 2024-2025 price cycles, and no liquidity friction or order flow imbalance explains the deviation, then the hypothesis is falsified.
